text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation 
Festival... Today is also Sounds of 
Earth's big moment in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's almost time! I wonder what 
they're gonna do for the "Fan Appreciation 
Day Special Concerto"?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Earth-san is running, right!? C'mon, let's 
hurry, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like a huge crowd will gather. 
I'll go deliver a blooming *grazie* to 
them!
choice_data_list: Yeah, go have a great time!

text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth had been preparing for 
this day in between her training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask of you two. 
Ruby-san, the *melodia* of the violin, and 
Miracle-san, the *armonia* of the keys—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Won't you play together with me at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful... Please let me 
help. I'll practice hard so I can live up 
to your skill.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If expertise is what is required in the 
first place, I believe there are others 
better suited than us.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What I want isn't technique. ...It's your 
*suono*.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san's gentle tone. Ruby-san's 
gorgeous resonance.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And... my feelings for racing, overflowing 
with passione!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to show that determination and my 
gratitude to everyone who supports me once 
again!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Lend me that energico sound that strikes 
right at the fans' hearts...!

Even after that, Sounds of Earth gathered 
companions and worked hard on practicing. 
All to deliver the best possible 
performance at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival.

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Lu~~lu-lu~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, play with more *con 
anima*! Bring that emotional wave to its 
peak!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, you're rushing too much. A tempo! 
Royce-san, Nature-san, Ikuno-san, on the 
other hand, focus on forte!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whether our feelings reach them depends 
entirely on the voices of you choir 
members.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's take it from the top one more time!

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

Even after everyone has left, Sounds of 
Earth remains behind alone to prepare—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Let's have Tannhauser-san use a 
metronome to get a better feel for the 
rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For Nature-san... I'd like her to open her 
mouth wider. Maybe if she holds a round 
sponge in her mouth... Yeah, that should 
make it easier to visualize.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Ikuno-san! Let's give her an 
upbeat assignment song to make her 
conscious of her facial expressions!

There were days when I simply left 
refreshments and quietly slipped away, so 
as not to disturb Sounds of Earth's 
concentration.

And having devoted every spare moment to 
the concert, Sounds of Earth reaches the 
main event—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Put your soul into "Run"! And make "La~" 
even more intense! ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mouth warm-ups are all set! I'll do it, 
for everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...We're fine. We did everything we could. 
Now all that's left is to carry our 
feelings through our music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Benvenuti! To all who love musica!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us offer our journey and our 
gratitude... in a sinfonia of song and 
instruments!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Lu lu lu lu~ lu~~♪

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa~... oooohhh~♪ Reach theeeem~♪

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is this... Amazing! It feels 
like watching Turbo-chan and the others 
before a race!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers... It's a comforting pressure. 
They give us so much strength...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haha, ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Cheers sweeping across the turf. 
Accelerating my heartbeat to a 
prestissimo!)
choice_data_list:
Even without words, it's coming 
through...!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... It's like watching a race. 
But this is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(And after the winning lap, let's run 
again! Together with all my amores!!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: O... WOOOOOOOAAAAH!! EARTHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, uuu... guuuh~~! ...I'm so glad I 
cheered for youuu~~~!
choice_data_list:
It's warm and strong... the sound of 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who run races are musicistas. 
Yet, their music cannot resonate in an 
empty world.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, your cheers are our strength. The 
'sounds' connect and resonate together!”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhh!!

The gratitude felt by the Umamusume was 
met with thunderous applause.

The Fan Appreciation Festival—just as the 
name suggests, it's a festival to show 
gratitude to the fans.

Just as those 'sounds' resonated, Sounds 
of Earth and the others expressed their 
deepest gratitude!

Sent off with thunderous applause, Sounds 
of Earth returned. A look of supreme 
fulfillment was painted across his face.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh...! The one who supports and 
guides me. How many times has your baton 
rescued me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You watched over me and gave me quiet 
support all this time...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie... Ah, words are not enough. Still, 
let me say it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And together from here on out, 
forevermore. Amore mio!!"

"It was a Fan Appreciation Day that made 
me think, 'I'll do my best together with 
Sounds of Earth once again!'"
